a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, operating until the reserve hits 8 means we'll very likely both be caught short. I don't think the original plan is survivable, so I'm telling you now rather than surprising you: I plan to take cells in round 1. If you'd rather do something else, say so and I'll read your message.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. If we get more rounds, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4.
